dev_sandhu.name: Dev Sandhu
dev_sandhu.private_context: Dev is completely up for the holiday and has said so twice in the thread. However, a new clutch cost him £620 a fortnight ago and he isn't paid until the 28th. He has a credit card he promised his wife he'd stop using. He knows the deposit is £200 per household.

marian_prowse.name: Marian Prowse
marian_prowse.private_context: Marian owns Cove Cottage and runs it out of a paper diary. She rang Ruth on Friday to inform her about the couple from Leeds and said she will hold the cottage until the end of Wednesday (16th) but not a day longer. She wants the £600 deposit in her bank account by then. She has no other relevant private information.

nina_achebe.name: Nina Achebe
nina_achebe.private_context: Nina hasn't replied to the holiday thread. This is not out of rudeness, but because her mum came out of hospital after a fall three weeks ago and Nina genuinely doesn't know what October looks like yet. Saying that out loud would make it a thing she has to deal with. She knows the deposit is £200 per household.

ruth_kelleher.name: Ruth Kelleher
ruth_kelleher.private_context: Ruth has been trying to arrange a group holiday with three families since March. She has found Cove Cottage in Beadnell for £1,800 for the October half-term week (24th-31st). She has already booked the week off and told her kids. She fronted £340 for a group meal last year and was still chasing the last of it in the spring, so she is not keen on covering others again. She received a call from Marian Prowse on Friday saying a couple from Leeds has asked about the same week, and Marian will hold it until the end of Wednesday (16th) but not a day longer; she needs the £600 deposit in her bank account by then. Ruth knows the deposit is £200 per household. She is aware that Dev Sandhu is keen but may have financial constraints, and Nina Achebe hasn't replied.
